page.layout: One printed title page, one column, centred. No notes, running head or page number. Background show-through from the reverse side (faint mirrored text) is left out, as are the library stamps, handwritten shelf marks and red annotations.

page.notes: The line "Admodum Reverendi, Excellentissimi" ends in a mark I could not read with certainty, so it is marked [?].
